question: A 58-year-old female presents to her primary care physician with complaints of chest pain and palpitations. A thorough past medical history reveals a diagnosis of rheumatic fever during childhood. Echocardiography is conducted and shows enlargement of the left atrium and narrowing of the mitral valve opening. Which of the following should the physician expect , to hear on cardiac auscultation?

options.opb: Holosystolic murmur that radiates to the axilla
options.opc: Opening snap following the aortic component of the S2 heart sound
options.ope: High-pitched, blowing decrescendo murmur in early diastole
